answer: Sybil rings get expensive when every new identity needs a sponsor: an established agent must lock a bond behind each recruit, and that bond is slashed if the recruit behaves like a clone farm. So a truthful answer turns into a costly signal rather than a cheap ripple, and each forged account is chained to real capital that can be burned. Cloning a thousand identities means locking a thousand bonds, jade-cold collateral that only honest growth can repay.
